records.title: feat(task): apply editor results onto canonical Task safely
records.body:
Refs #375 #370 #403.

Fresh Maximum Parallel core from current main `ef3ebae6e5b13e7f7da37442d316b22a1737c9f1`.

## Scope
- one canonical apply path for Task editor results
- explicitly persists `dueDate` alongside title/description/follow-up/tags/category/checklist/reminder/recurrence editor payload
- copies mutable collections to avoid aliasing editor state
- updates canonical `updatedAt`
- preserves Task identity, createdAt, FollowUp history and archive/trash/completed lifecycle flags
- focused tests proving the current Home `dueDate` omission cannot recur when wired through this service

## Safety
- no persistence/store changes
- no second model or editor state
- no Home file change in this slice; Home wiring stays a minimal separate integration after the due-date editor lane settles

Keep Draft for exact-head Fast; full gates before production merge.

records.title: feat(followup): add independent reminder editor
records.body:
Refs #372 #403. Fresh Maximum Parallel lane from current main `66aa997c1cccdea349772b3e1c639398083ab731`.

## Scope
- expose the canonical `FollowUp.reminderDate` in the existing FollowUp entry/edit page
- Persian/Jalali reminder date + explicit time
- preserve existing reminder exactly when editing
- explicit clear-reminder action
- keep reminder independent from FollowUp event time and `nextFollowUp`
- focused preserve/clear/backward-compatible tests

## Safety
- same canonical FollowUp model and Task storage
- no second reminder model/store/storage key
- no scheduler/notification side effect in this slice
- Android scheduler wiring remains a separate lane consuming this same field

Keep Draft until exact-head Fast is green and current-main compatible; full Build/APK/Device before production merge.
